Theorem
[Smoothness]

↗ def:ball-mean-value-property ↗ thm:mean-value-formulas-laplace

1. ch2:2.2-thm-6\group Harmonic Functions

If $u\in C(U)$ has the mean-value property (16) on every ball compactly contained in $U$, then $u\in C^\infty (U)$.
Proof

\sketch Let $\eta $ be a radial standard mollifier and set $u^\varepsilon =\eta _\varepsilon *u$ on $U_\varepsilon =\{ x\in U:\dist (x,\partial U)>\varepsilon \} $. Polar coordinates and the spherical mean-value formula give

\[ u^\varepsilon (x) =\frac1{\varepsilon ^n}\int _0^\varepsilon \eta (r/\varepsilon )\left(\int _{\partial B(x,r)}u\, dS\right)dr =u(x)\int \eta _\varepsilon =u(x). \]

Thus $u$ agrees locally with a smooth mollification.

□
